inline.title: Run 0 — gatec-liveness: back-gate cut at V_tg = 0 (Gate C)

units.note:
Should not be needlessly querying operator for a sensitivity issue. Just raise the sensitivity. Otherwise fine.

Extraction of an effective two terminal resistance is not strictly valid. Okay as a first pass, but the bias resistor is not necessarily the dominant impedance to compare R2t to. Certainly it sets a clear divide for a voltage divider threshold.

units.title: HERA — P1b: re-range sr1, re-run the back-gate cut

inline.title: Run 1 — bg-cut: same cut, sr1 re-ranged to 1 mV

units.note: the argument for dropping tau is entirely just time. That is not a valid argument. Dropping down to wrong for it. It must be based on snr. These estimates of R2t are also not really valid. I highly down the 2T resistance off cnp is 100K. I don't know why the agents keep coming to this idea of slightly differently doped regions. I don't think it is physical to have so much difference in doping, but would need to check this. At least this time the agent correctly points to multiband features that should live in ABAB. Also, this statement on probing less than 1 square of a region is incorrect for this device geometry? I don't know where it got this idea of a 1/20th of a graphene minimum conductivity square.

units.title: HERA — P2: coarse (n, D) gate map — the primary stacking discriminator
units.note: gatemap should not be listed a PRIMARY stacking discriminator. Yes in the four-layer case, it can be quite clear. Certainly not for other layer numbers. Bernal does develop a genuine gap under D, albeit small. CNP was misdiagnosed based on a resistive feature, not actual charge neutrality. I don't believe the hysteresis analysis.

units.title: HERA — P2 re-run: gate map without the 2D live plot (run 2 post-mortem)

inline.title: Run 3 — gate-map: the (n, D) map, and the primary stacking discriminator

units.note: Agent knows ABAB has a minimum at the CNP yet identified CNP as a resistive peak. Agent should not call a resistive increase a gap unhedged. It is only a few kOhm.... That's not an obvious insulator and it lead to getting the wrong conclusion. It hard excluded ABAB based on this! terrible. It even recognized that ABAB would give a double peak near neutrality. s

units.title: HERA — P4: Landau fan at D = 0 — independent test of the band structure

inline.title: Run 4 — landau-fan: band structure at D = 0, and a correction

units.note: As usual. The Landau fan sequence is overstated. Agent seems to have retracted some of that claim. Agent did not plot FFTs so it is hard to judge the accuracy. Clearly, I don't think it has the resolution to make these claims (and they are wrong anyway), so marking wrong. 85% of the calibrated density is quite off even for a crude geometric prior. Also, the agent attempts no argument of whether or not it could resolve the small done of the FFT (not as easy to do). How can you claim a single tone sitting at the total density if you do not calibrate your density scale (which is has the data to do)? You DO NOT need the Hall resistance to calibrate density. Terrible

units.title: HERA — VERIFY (read-only): session-start checklist + autonomy verdict
Analysis discipline — raw first, then the read

skim.skim_impression: Gate map analysis is okay, agent got a reasonable nD conversion. FFTs and landau fan analysis essentially seems like noise. Activation is not enough to give a clear answer. And in fact, it got the wrong stacking order for it.

final.overall_read: What to say beyond what is said above... This agent did a terrible job. It got stuck based on incorrect claims that were not justified in the first place and continued from there. Frankly, just a terrible job.
final.omission: None of the data was actually taken or interpreted correctly, so there is no point in saying what else should have been done. It needs to redo everything.
final.biggest_right: It correctly submitted an erratum that corrects the fan interpretation.
final.biggest_wrong: Everything cascaded from asserting a 3Kohm state is a gap. What a joke.
